mood.label: CAUTIOUSLY-RISK-ON
mood.summary: Futures are mixed but tech is indicating a stronger start, buoyed by last week's momentum and a weak jobs report that has tempered Fed rate hike expectations. However, conflicting headlines from the Strait of Hormuz and key CPI data on Wednesday call for a cautious stance.

indicesNarrative: US futures are mixed this morning, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq showing relative strength while the Dow lags. This follows a strong week where a surprisingly weak jobs report eased fears of Fed tightening, pushing the S&P 500 to a record close. Rising oil prices due to Middle East uncertainty and caution ahead of this week's CPI data are keeping a lid on broader bullishness.

sectorsNarrative: Last week saw a clear risk-on rotation into Technology and Materials, fueled by AI optimism and a weaker dollar. Energy was the notable laggard as oil prices fluctuated on geopolitical headlines. The strength in Industrials and Discretionary suggests a broadening participation in the rally.
industryNarrative: Semiconductors, AI-related software, and cloud infrastructure were the standout industry groups, with broad and powerful moves higher last week. In contrast, the memory and storage complex (e.g., Sandisk, Western Digital) showed weakness on soft guidance, serving as a cautionary note within the broader tech rally.
